items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kirby used to be the bass player with Fletcher Henderson’s band.

ctx.x: What about your time with John Kirby?

Interesting, because he had Bill Beason, Buster Bailey. That took Billy Cobham’s place for a while. I was overtime. I played with the band sure maybe a couple of months. But Charlie Shavers used to do a lot of the writing for the band. Of course, you know Charlie, he kept playing higher, and higher, and higher. Ease to play the highest notes on the horn. He was a good player. He was a good arranger. He was a very good arrangement and I enjoyed the band. Kirby used to be the bass player with Fletcher Henderson’s…
In 1947, how did you get to Jazz at the Philharmonic? How did I come to be?
